# ParcelsApp

> > Universal parcel tracking platform supporting 1000+ global carriers with AI-powered multi-carrier tracking, embeddable widgets, and support for major ecommerce platforms.

ParcelsApp is a comprehensive package tracking service that enables users to track shipments across major international carriers including USPS, UPS, China Post, DHL, and ecommerce platforms like AliExpress and eBay. The platform offers both free tracking and a premium Pro tier with advanced features, available in 10+ languages to serve a global audience.

## Key Topics

- Multi-carrier tracking
- International shipping
- Package tracking
- Parcel delivery
- China Post
- USPS
- UPS
- Courier services
- Ecommerce tracking
- Tracking numbers
- Global logistics
- Postal services
- AliExpress
- eBay
- Order tracking

## Core Products

- [ParcelsApp](https://parcelsapp.com): Homepage for global parcel tracking across USPS, UPS, and ecommerce platforms
- [Parcels Pro](https://parcelsapp.com/pro): Premium product offering advanced multi-carrier tracking with AI features

## Supported Carriers

- [Courier and Postal Services](https://parcelsapp.com/en/carriers): Directory of supported carriers including USPS, Royal Mail, Canada Post, and 1000+ global couriers
- [China Post Tracking](https://parcelsapp.com/en/carriers/china-post): Tracking guide for China Post Registered Mail, EMS, and ePacket
- [USPS Tracking](https://parcelsapp.com/en/carriers/usps): Tracking guide for US Postal Service and domestic mail delivery

## Integration & Developer Tools

- [Embeddable Tracking Widget](https://parcelsapp.com/tracking-widget): Integration guide for embedding ParcelsApp tracking widget on websites
